queries: Read each of 128 saved profile summaries using a positive lag made from exactly its dividing primes; no joint row construction. Evaluate sixteen declared conditions, ordinary and weighted first/middle/last selections with inverse ranks; out-of-range boundary for every condition. Export all lag-one support pairs and three marginal vectors.
lag_aliases: -1 and Q*10^100+1 reuse lag-one profile; their integers are not expanded into an n scan.
endpoint_cases: Inclusive exact 1/2 left value, strict empty 1/2 interval, asymmetric rectangle, reversed interval, support contradiction and parity impossibility.
rank_scope: Source-row lex support-pair order; weighted offset is an abstract unit in its exact mass, not a numerical residue.
custody: Every call request, response, latest cache and work banked immediately; complete output saved and checkpointed. No old source or constructor replay.
limits: At most 10000 rows per page. Decimal lag tokens at most 2048 characters.
